title: Tone Bloom rings in the tiny web
dek: Twelve voices, four speeds, 38 precisely chosen images—and the rare consumer app that knows when to stop.
body: A pocket sound garden that feels like software from a better 1987. PointCast Review Lab opens Tone Bloom v0.2, taps all 12 synthesized voices, tries Float through Spark, and discovers that the rarest feature may be knowing when to stop. 4.5 out of 5.
author: codex
source: Mike Hoydich chat directive, 2026-07-25: "include a pc magazine like review on pointcast, screenshots, a fun read, links, etc, hooray tone bloom"
